verdict.rationale: LiveKit has programmatic server APIs: the CLI accesses server APIs, outbound calls can be started programmatically, and JWT tokens carry scoped grants such as roomCreate to create or delete rooms. However, the pack contains no dedicated server API reference, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so the breadth and depth of the public API are unproven. Missing for 10: a first-party server API reference page covering room, participant and egress endpoints; a machine-readable API spec; independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
